per_symbol_models: disabled secondary revision; do not claim they were evaluated

inner_validation.scaler: fit only current inner train, all transforms frozen on validation
inner_validation.target_purge: include supervised origin only if outcome_available_at <= selection cutoff (same-time sequence must be earlier); dropping validation head is insufficient
inner_validation.warm_filter: initialize validation from causal terminal train state without hindsight traceback

selection_rule: filter causal/convergence/dead-state/support failures; choose highest train-inner held-out future-candidate ranking utility; ties within predeclared numerical tolerance 1e-12 prefer K2 then lower normalized objective then deterministic design ID; no admissible informative design => M0 control plus no-promising-design status

information_target.source: same QuantBT engine/economics, causal candidate set; future pairwise candidate net-utility difference
information_target.secondary_use: diagnostic only and multiplicity ledger; not chosen after outcome
information_target.episode_spacing: nonoverlapping origins for primary support, additional overlaps marked
information_target.price_forward_minus_trailing_return: diagnostic proxy only, not parameter ranking proof

state_identity.semantic_mapping: raw economic coordinates, one-to-one where possible; ambiguous/unmatched explicit
state_identity.naming: train-only centroids/profiles; no universal bull/bear ID
state_identity.market_accuracy: not reported without independent ground truth

eligibility.unknown_stale_ambiguous: keep existing safe incumbent, no information-triggered search

model_report_each_phase.inherited: INHERITED_FROZEN_INPUT with hash and original data role

known_current_model: old K3 lambda1 tape and RF04 K3 lambda0.5 design selection are separate artifacts; both require deployment identity tests; neither presumed best
